page.overview:
Who is Doc?

Doc is a character in the IDW comics related to the First Strike event.

The original Doc's daughter. G.I. Joe's medic in the "Homefront" comic series. When Doc's hand was injured in battle, she guided Quick Kick through the process of removing shrapnel from Ship-Wreck's chest to save him.

Doc and Quick Kick appear in Optimus Prime starting in issue 10, which leads into First Strike. Category:Female Characters Category:Characters Category:IDW Characters Category:G.I. Joe Team
